entries.englishValue: Bitcoin doesn't have inflation
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ayinayo inkomba yenfleshini

entries.englishValue: Inflation means your money buys you less over time. Bitcoin is better money because it doesn't have inflation.
entries.targetTranslation: Inkomba yenfleshini isho ukuthi imali yakho ithenga okuncane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. I-Bitcoin yimali engcono ngoba ayinayo inkomba yenfleshini.

entries.englishValue: because it has a maximum supply of 21 million Bitcoin. No one can print more Bitcoin.

entries.englishValue: Dollars have an unlimited supply, which means more can be printed at any time.

entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin yivelakancane

entries.englishValue: Historically, Bitcoin has gained purchasing power over time while the dollar has lost it. Many people use Bitcoin as their long-term savings account: money that they can leave alone and let grow for several years.
entries.targetTranslation: Ngokomlando, i-Bitcoin iye yathola amandla okuthenga ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, kanti idola lase-Australia kuye kwawalahlekelwa. Abantu abaningi basebenzisa i-Bitcoin njenge-akhawunti yokulondoloza yesikhathi eside — imali abayishiya ikhula iminyaka bengayithinti.

entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in dollars that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?
entries.targetTranslation: Ungathanda kanjani: ukulondoloza ngamadola ase-Australia athenga okuncane ngokuhamba kwesikhathi? Noma ulondoloze nge-Bitcoin, eye yathenga okuningi ngokomlando?

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is also a tool for freedom
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin futhi iyithuluzi lenkululeko

entries.englishValue: The Bitcoin network isn't owned by anyone. It isn't controlled by any government or corporation. It's designed to uphold your freedom and protect your money.
entries.targetTranslation: Inethiwekhi ye-Bitcoin ayiphethwe muntu. Ayilawulwa noma yimuphi uhulumeni noma yimuphi inkampani. Yakhelwe ukuvikela inkululeko yakho nemali yakho.

entries.englishValue: People around the world are already using Bitcoin to protect their freedom — even when their own governments refused to help or tried to stop them.
entries.targetTranslation: Abantu emhlabeni wonke sebevele besebenzisa i-Bitcoin ukuvikela inkululeko yabo — ngisho noma ohulumeni babo benqaba ukubasiza noma bezama ukubavimba.

entries.englishValue: If you save in Australian Dollars, you've probably noticed that they buy you less each year. It takes more dollars to buy the same amount of food. You need more dollars to maintain your quality of life.
entries.targetTranslation: Uma ulondoloza ngamadola ase-Australia, mhlawumbe usuke wabona ukuthi minyaka yonke athenga okuncane. Udinga amadola ase-Australia amaningi ukuthenga inani elifanayo lezimpahla. Udinga amadola ase-Australia amaningi ukuze ulondoloze izinga lakho lokuphila.

entries.englishValue: But it doesn't have to be this way.
entries.targetTranslation: Kodwa akudingeki kube njalo.

entries.englishValue: People who saved in Bitcoin over the last 4 years saw life get cheaper.
entries.targetTranslation: Eminyakeni emine edlule, abantu abalondoloze nge-Bitcoin babone impilo iya ngokushibha.

entries.englishValue: The dollars in your bank account buy you less every year. That's because there is no fixed limit on how many dollars can be created.
entries.targetTranslation: amadola ase-Australia asengaku-akhawunti yakho yasebhange athenga okuncane minyaka yonke. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi awukho umkhawulo wenani lama-amadola ase-Australia angakhiqizwa.

entries.englishValue: This unlimited supply is the root cause of inflation. Over recent years, the total amount of dollars in existence has increased dramatically.
entries.targetTranslation: Ukukhiqizwa okungenamkhawulo yiwona umsuka wenfleshini. Eminyakeni embalwa edlule, isamba sama-amadola ase-Australia asazungeza simbe sikhule kakhulu.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin isebenza kunethiwekhi engacentralized ngempela enezinkulungwane zamashumi ama-node azimele emhlabeni wonke. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto alawulwa ngama-foundation, izinkampani, noma amaqoqo amancane ababhali abangathatha izinqumo ngokuswela ukusondelana ngekusasa lenqubo.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin isebenza emashumini ezinkulungwane zama-node azimele emhlabeni wonke. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto alawulwa ngama-foundation, izinkampani, noma amaqembu amancane abathuthukisi abangenza izinguquko ngokungayingi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin inomkhawulo oqinile wezinhlamvu ezingu-21 million ezizokhona, okuyenza ibe yinto yedijithali enqabile kunazo zonke. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto anamanani angenamkhawulo, izindlela zenfleshini, noma angakha amathokheni amasha ngokukhululeka, okunciphisa inani labanikazi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin inomkhawulo oqinile wezinhlamvu ezingu-21 million — impahla yedijithali enqabe kunazo zonke. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto anokukhiqizwa okungenamkhawulo noma izindlela zokukhiqiza amathokheni amasha ngokuthanda, anciphise abanikazi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin inenjongo eyodwa elula: imali yedijithali yontanga-ku-ntanga. Noma ubani angayiqonda futhi ayisebenzise ngolwazi oluyisisekelo. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto afaka izinkontileka ezihlakaniphile eziyinkimbinkimbi, izinqubo ze-DeFi, noma izindlela zokulawula ezidinga ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe ukuze usebenzise ngokuphepha.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin inenjongo eyodwa: imali yedijithali yontanga-ku-ntanga. Noma ubani angayiqonda futhi ayisebenzise. Ama-crypto amaningi afaka izinkontileka ezihlakaniphile eziyinkimbinkimbi noma i-DeFi edinga ulwazi lwezobuchwepheshe ukuze isetshenziswe ngokuphepha.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. Many crypto projects use experimental consensus mechanisms like Proof of Stake or delegated systems that haven't proven their long-term security.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin isebenzisa ukuvumelana kwe-Proof of Work, okuhlolwe emphini iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-15 ngaphandle kohlaselo oluphumelele olulodwa kunethiwekhi eyinhloko. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto asebenzisa izindlela zokuvumelana ezihlolwayo efana ne-Proof of Stake noma izinhlelo ezabeliwe ezingakaqinisekisi ukuphepha kwazo kwesikhathi eside.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Proof of Work ye-Bitcoin isebenze ngaphandle kohlaselo oluphumelele kunethiwekhi eyinhloko iminyaka engaphezu kwengu-15. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto asebenzisa ukuvumelana okuhlolwayo okungakahlolwa empini.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin isebenza njengomali yedijithali - indawo yokugcina inani kanye nensizakalo yokushintshanisa. Amathokheni amaningi e-crypto angamathokheni okusebenzisa amapulatifomu athile, amathokheni okulawula, noma impahla yokuhlola eneziphakamiso zenani lomhlaba wangempela ezingacacile.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin iyimali yedijithali — indawo yokugcina inani nemidiya yokushintshanisa. Amathokheni amaningi e-crypto ayimathokheni okuthengiselana noma okulawula anenani lomhlaba wangempela elingacacile.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin iba namandla ngaphansi kokuhlasela futhi isindile kuyo yonke inkinga, ukuvalwa, nokusolwa okuthunyelwe kuyo. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto abuthakathaka futhi angawa ngenxa yengcindezi yezomthetho, izinkinga zobuchwepheshe, noma ukwehla kwezimakethe.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin iya iqina ngaphansi kokuhlasela futhi yasinda kuyo yonke inkinga, ukuvalwa, nokusolwa. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto awa ngenxa yengcindezi yezomthetho, ezobuchwepheshe, noma yemakethe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ayinayo i-CEO, ayinankampani emva kwayo, futhi ayinandawo eyodwa yokuhluleka. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto aesekwa yizinkampani ze-venture capital, anobuholi obuhlonzekayo, noma ancike ezinkampanini ezithile ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ayinayo i-CEO, ayinankampani, ayinandawo eyodwa yokuhluleka. Amaphrojekthi amaningi e-crypto ancike kuma-VC, ebuholini obuthile, noma ekuphileni kwenkampani eyodwa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is perfectly fungible, meaning every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Fine art is non-fungible by nature, with each piece being unique in its creation, history, condition, and provenance, making direct comparisons and valuations extremely difficult.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ishintshana ngokuphelele, okusho ukuthi i-bitcoin ngayinye iyafana futhi iyashintshana - i-bitcoin eyodwa ilingana ne-bitcoin eyodwa noma kuphi emhlabeni. Ubuciko obukhethekile abuhlukani ngokwemvelo, ngoba yilowo nalowo umsebenzi ungcono ekudalweni kwawo, emlandweni, esimeni, nasekuthatheni, okwenza ukuqhathanisa nokulinganiswa kube nzima kakhulu.
entries.targetTranslation: Yonke i-bitcoin iyafana futhi iyashintshana. Wonke umsebenzi wobuciko uyahluka — ukudalwa okuhlukile, umlando, isimo, nokuphuma kwenza ukuqhathaniswa okuqondile kube nzima kakhulu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ithengiswa emakethe yomhlaba yangu-24/7 lapho noma ubani onokufinyelela ku-inthanethi engathengisa ngokushesha. Ubuciko obukhethekile budinga izindlu ze-auction ezikhethekile efana ne-Sotheby's noma ne-Christie's, abathengisi abangasese, noma amagalari akhethekile. Ukuthengisa kungathatha izinyanga ukulungisa nokuqeda, ngokufinyelela kwemakethe okulinganiselwe namathuba okuthengisa angajwayelekile.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ithengiswa 24/7 emakethe yomhlaba etholakala kunoma ubani. Ubuciko obukhethekile budinga izindlu ze-auction ezikhethekile, abathengisi abangasese, noma amagalari, futhi kungathatha izinyanga ukuthengisa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: Ukuthenga noma ukuthengisa i-bitcoin ngokuvamile kubiza ngaphansi kwe-1% ngezimali, ngokuvamile ngaphansi kakhulu. Ukuthengisa kobuciko obukhethekile kufaka izindleko ezinkulu kufaka i-premium yomthengi (10-25%), ikhomishini yomthengisi (10-15%), umshwalense, ukuthutha, ukugcina, nezimali zokuqinisekisa. Lezi zindleko ezihlangene zingadlula kalula 30-40% yenani lobuciko ngokwenzeka okukodwa.
entries.targetTranslation: Ukuthenga noma ukuthengisa i-Bitcoin kubiza ngaphansi kwe-1% ngezimali, ngokuvamile ngaphansi kakhulu. Ukuthengiswa kobuciko kufaka u-30–40% ngezimali zomthengi, amakhomishini, umshwalense, ukuthutha, nokuqinisekisa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ingahlukaniswa izingxenye ezingu-100 million ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-satoshi, okuyenza ibe yinhle ezinkokhelweni zanoma yisiphi isilinganiso kusukela kwezincane kakhulu kuya ezinkulu. Ubuciko obukhethekile abukwazi ukuhlukaniswa - awukwazi ukuba nesiqephu sepeni noma uthengise ingxenye yesibazi kuphela. Lokhu kungahlukaniseki kunciphisa izinketho zokutshalomali nokuthengiseka.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin yahlukaniswa ngama-sats angu-100 million, okuyenza ibe yinhle kunoma yisiphi isayizi senkokhelo. Awukwazi ukuba nesiqephu sepeni noma ikhona yesibazi ngaphandle kwengozi yohlangothi oluphikisanayo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Ubunini be-Bitcoin nobuqiniso bukwazi ukuqinisekiswa nge-cryptography ku-blockchain yinoma ubani onolwazi oluyisisekelo lwezobuchwepheshe. Ubuciko obukhethekile budinga ukuqinisekiswa kwezingcweti okubizayo, ucwaningo lokuthathwa, nokuhlaziya kwesayensi. Ngisho nangokuqinisekiswa kwezingcweti, okokukopisha ngokukhohlisa kuvame ukukhohlisa izwe lobuciko, futhi izimpikiswano zokuqinisekisa zingabhubhisa inani lobuciko ngobusuku obubodwa. I-Bitcoin, ngakolunye uhlangothi, ayikwazi ukukopishwa ngokukhohlisa.
entries.targetTranslation: Ubunini be-Bitcoin nobuqiniso kungaqinisekiswa nge-cryptography ku-blockchain ngumuntu noma ubani. Ukuqinisekiswa kobuciko kuyabiza, kuyahamba kancane, futhi kusakhohliswa abakopishi — okubhubhisa inani lobuciko ngobusuku obubodwa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin, lapho igcinwe ngendlela efanele, ayikwazi ukubhujiswa yizikhukhula, imililo, ukuzamazama komhlaba, iziphepho, ukwebiwa, noma ezinye izinhlekelele. Ubuciko obukhethekile busengozini kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokubhubhisa ngokomzimba nokuphelelwa. Ngisho nanokukhishwa okubizayo okuqondene nemvelo nomshwalense ophelele, imisebenzi yobuciko ingalimala yizimo zemvelo, izingozi, noma izinhlekelele zemvelo, okungaholela ekulahlekelweni kwenani lonke.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin, lapho igcinwe ngendlela efanele, isinda ezikhukhuleni, emililweni, ekuzamazameni komhlaba, nokwebiwa. Ubuciko obukhethekile busengozini kuwo wonke umoya wokubhubhisa ngokomzimba, futhi umshwalense awumbozi konke.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ingathengwa futhi ithengiswe yinoma ubani onokungeniswa ku-inthanethi nenani elincane lemali yokutshalomali. Ukutshalomali kobuciko obukhethekile kulinganiselwe kakhulu kubaqoqi abacebile ngenxa yamanani aphezulu amancane, ukufinyelela kwe-auction okukhethekile, izidingo zokugcina, izindleko zomshwalense, nolwazi olukhethekile oludingekayo ukuze uhambe ngempumelelo emakethe yobuciko.
entries.targetTranslation: Noma ubani onokuxhumana ne-inthanethi nemali encane angathenga i-Bitcoin. Ukutshalomali kobuciko obukhethekile kuvamile ukulinganiselwa kubaqoqi abacebile abanokufinyelela kwe-auction nolwazi olukhethekile.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Ngoba i-Bitcoin iyidijithali, ingathunyelelwa ngokushesha cishe ngezimali eziphansi kakhulu yinoma ubani onokuxhumana ne-Inthanethi. Ngoba igolide lingokoqobo, alikwazi ukuhamba nge-Inthanethi futhi kumele lithunyelwe ngokwenyama ukuze kudluliselwe ubunini.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ingathunyelelwa ngokushesha nge-inthanethi ngezimali eziphansi. Igolide kumele lithunyelwe ngokwenyama ukuze kudluliselwe ubunini.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin iyinto yedijithali ngokwemvelo, okusho ukuthi ungadlulisela ubunini obuphelele ngayo nge-Inthanethi. Ezinye izinkampani zinikeza ithuba lokuthenga igolide ku-inthanethi ngaphandle kokuthola igolide lengokoqobo langempela, kunalokho uthembe inkampani ukuba ikugcinele igolide. Lokhu kufana ne-Digital IOU ngoba unobunini besithembiso kuphela esivela enkampanini esikhundleni sento uqobo.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin iyimpahla yedijithali ngokwemvelo ongayihambisa nge-inthanethi. Igolide elise-inthanethi liyi-Digital IOU — unobunini besithembiso esivela kumgcini, hhayi insimbi uqobo.

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Igolide elisha likhishwa emhlabathini unyaka ngamunye, okuholela ekunfleshinini yenani eliphelele. Kulinganiselwa ukuthi inani eliphelele legolide likhula ngamaphesenti angaba ngu-1.6% unyaka ngamunye, okusho ukuthi icesho lakho lephaya linciphile ngamaphesenti angu-1.6% unyaka ngamunye.

entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.

entries.targetTranslation: ye-fiat — kodwa kusayinfleshini.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Igolide linenani elinwebeka, okusho ukuthi njengoba intengo yegolide ikhula, kukhona ukukhuthaza okukhulu kokumba igolide elingaphezulu. Lokhu kuvame ukufaka ingcindezi yokwehla entengeweni yegolide njengoba amamayini amasha eqalisa.
entries.targetTranslation: Lapho intengo yegolide ikhuphuka, kumbiwa elidlulele, kupushe intengo phansi. Ukukhiqizwa kwe-Bitcoin akunwebeki — noma intengo iya kuyiphi indawo, kuyoba khona kuphela u-21 million.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Inethiwekhi ye-Bitcoin engacentralized.
entries.targetTranslation: Amashumi ezinkulungwane zama-node azimele aqinisekisa inethiwekhi ye-Bitcoin. Iningi legolide elingokoqobo lihlala ezimbadwini ezimbalwa zezigcina ezinkulu.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Nge-Bitcoin, kulula kakhulu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi unayo i-Bitcoin yangempela ngokuzigcinela izinhlamvu zakho futhi usebenzise i-full node.
entries.targetTranslation: Noma ubani angaqinisekisa i-Bitcoin yangempela ngokusebenzisa i-full node — kuyiphi nje uhlelo lokusebenza. Ukuqinisekisa igolide elingokoqobo kudinga ukuliqothula; ngaphakathi kungaba i-tungsten.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Njengoba kunamasenti angu-100 kudola eli-1, kunama-satoshi angu-100,000,000 ku-Bitcoin e-1. Lokhu kuvumela i-Bitcoin isetshenziswe kuzo zonke izilinganiso zokuthenga, kufaka phakathi izinkokhelo ezincane kakhulu njengamasenti ambalwa.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin yahlukaniswa ngama-sats angu-100 million, okuyenza ibe yinhle kunoma yiluphi usayizi lokuthenga. Igolide alikwazi ukuhlukaniswa kalula ezinkokhelweni ezincane.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ingahanjiswa noma kuphi emhlabeni ngokushesha nge-inthanethi. Izindlu nempahla yimiselwe unomphela endaweni ethile futhi ayikwazi ukuhanjiswa, okuyenza ibe sengozini yezimo zomnotho wendawo, izinhlekelele zemvelo, nokungazinzi kwezepolitiki.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ihamba noma kuphi emhlabeni ngokushesha. Izindlu nempahla zibekwe endaweni eyodwa futhi zisengozini yezimo zomnotho wendawo, ezepolitiki, nezemvelo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ingahlukaniswa izingxenye ezingu-100 million ezincane ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-satoshi, okuyenza ibe yinhle ezinkokhelweni zanoma yisiphi isilinganiso. Izindlu nempahla azikwazi ukuhlukaniswa kalula - awukwazi ukuthengisa ikhishi lendlu yakho kuphela noma uthenge uhhafu wendlu yokulala.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin yahlukaniswa ngama-sats angu-100 million. Izindlu nempahla azikwazi ukuthengiswa ngokwengxenye — awukwazi ukuthengisa ikhishi kuphela noma uthenge uhhafu wegumbi lokulala.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin isebenza kunethiwekhi engacentralized engekho hulumeni ongayilawula. Izindlu nempahla ziphethwe yimithetho ebanzi kahulumeni kufaka phakathi ukulawula irenti, ukumisa ukuxoshwa, imithetho yokuhlelwa, nomthetho wokuphucwa lapho uhulumeni engathatha impahla yakho.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin isebenza kunethiwekhi engacentralized engelawulwa muntu. Izindlu nempahla zilawulwa kakhulu — ukulinganisa indawo, ukulawulwa kwerenti, umthetho wokuphucwa, nokuthathwa kufaka phakathi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ayidingi ukulungiswa - ikhona njengamakhodi edijithali kunethiwekhi. Izindlu nempahla zidinga ukunakekelwa njalo kufaka phakathi ukulungiswa, ukuvuselelwa, ukuphathwa kwempahla, umshwalense, nokuphatha abaqashi uma iqashisiwe.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ayidingi ukulungiswa. Izindlu zidinga ukulungiswa, ukuvuselelwa, umshwalense, ukuphathwa kwempahla, nezinkinga zabaqashi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ayinantela eqhubekayo - ukhokha intela yenzuzo kuphela lapho uthengisa. Izindlu nempahla ziphethwe yintela yempahla yonyaka ekumele ikhokhwe kungakhathaliseki ukuthi impahla ikhiqiza inzuzo yini, okukukuphoqa ukukhokhela uhulumeni impahla yakho unomphela.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ayinazintela ezilandelayo — ukhokha intela yenzuzo kuphela uma uthengisa. Izindlu zikweleta intela yempahla yonyaka kungakhathaliseki ukuthi inomholo.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin, lapho igcinwe ngendlela efanele, ayikwazi ukubhujiswa yizikhukhula, imililo, ukuzamazama komhlaba, iziphepho, noma ezinye izinhlekelele zemvelo. Izindlu nempahla zisengozini kuzo zonke izinhlobo zokubhubhisa ngokomzimba futhi zidinga umshwalense obizayo ongase ungambozi ngokuphelele ukulahlekelwa.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin, igcinwe ngendlela efanele, isinda emlilweni, ezikhukhuleni, nasekuzamazameni komhlaba. Izindlu zisengozini kuyo yonke inhlekelele, futhi umshwalense awumbozi konke.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: I-bitcoin ngayinye iyafana futhi iyashintshana - i-bitcoin eyodwa ilingana ne-bitcoin eyodwa noma kuphi emhlabeni. Impahla ngayinye yezindlu ihlukile ngendawo, isimo, nezici, okwenza kunzima ukubeka intengo nokuqhathanisa izimpahla.
entries.targetTranslation: Yonke i-bitcoin iyafana futhi iyashintshana. Yonke impahla yendlu iyahluka, okwenza ukubeka intengo nokuqhathanisa kube nzima.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ingathengwa futhi ithengiswe 24/7 yinoma ubani onokufinyelela ku-inthanethi noma kuphi emhlabeni. Ukuthengiswa kwezindlu nempahla kulinganiselwe kubathengi bendawo, kudinga izinqubo ezinde nabameli namajenti, futhi kungathatha izinyanga ukuqeda.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ithengiswa emhlabeni 24/7 yinoma ubani onokuxhumana ne-inthanethi. Ukuthengiswa kwezindlu kulinganiselwe kubathengi bendawo futhi kungathatha izinyanga zokuqeda amaphepha.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ivumela ubunini bomuntu ngamunye ngqo ngaphandle kwabaphakathi, ikhuthaza inkululeko yezezimali yawo wonke umuntu. Ukuthenga izindlu nempahla njengokutshalomali ngaphezu kwekhaya lakho elikhulu kufaka isandla ekuguqulweni kwezindlu zibe yimpahla yezezimali, ukuphatha izindlu njengezinto ezithengwayo kunokuthi zibe yindawo yokulala. Lokhu kuphakamisa intengo, kunciphisa ukukwazi ukuthenga kwemindeni, futhi kufaka isandla enkingeni yezindlu nokuhlala emgwaqeni ethinta amazwe amaningi namuhla.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ivumela ubunini bomuntu ngamunye obuqondile noma ubani. Ukuthenga izindlu njengokutshalomali ngaphezu kwekhaya lakho elikhulu kuphakamisa amanani ezindlu, kunciphise ukukwazi ukuthenga, futhi kufaka isandla enkingeni yezindlu.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Lapho unayo i-Bitcoin, unobunini ngqo bempahla uqobo. Lapho unamasheya, unesiqephu senkampani, okusho ukuthi ukutshalomali kwakho kuncike ekusebenzeni kwenkampani, ezinqumweni zobuholi, nasempumelelweni yebhizinisi.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin iyimpahla eqondile onayo ngokuphelele. Amasheya ayizinkamu zenkampani — inani lawo lincike kubaphathi, ekusebenzeni, nasezinqumweni ongenamandla wokuzilawula.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.

Ukutshalomali kwamasheya kuthintwa yingozi yomuntu obalulekile - uma i-CEO noma abaholi abanamandla bahamba, bagula, noma bathatha izinqumo ezimbi, ukutshalomali kwakho kungahlupheka kakhulu. entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Intengo ye-Bitcoin inqunywa yimakethe kuphela ngesidingo nemithombo. Intengo yamasheya ngokuvamile ihlolwa kusetshenziswa ama-P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), abonisa ukuthi abatshali zimali bakhokha malini ngayo yonke idola yenzuzo yenkampani. Ama-P/E ratios aphezulu angabonisa amasheya akhishwe kakhulu, okwenza kunzima ukuthola inani elifanele.
entries.targetTranslation: Intengo ye-Bitcoin ivela ezimakethe ezivulekile zomhlaba. Amanani amasheya ancike emizamweni efana ne-P/E ratios engasitha amasheya ahlangabezane nentengo eyeqile.

Stocks have variable performance against inflation - some companies do well during inflationary periods while others struggle. There's no guarantee that any particular stock will protect against inflation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's fixed supply makes it a reliable inflation hedge. Some stocks beat inflation, others don't — there's no guarantee.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is an open network anyone can join and use without permission. Visa is a closed system controlled by financial institutions that can deny access — especially to the unbanked and underbanked.

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Ukulandelela isisekelo sezindleko zakho kuzoba umehluko omkhulu kakhulu phakathi kokubala amadola nokubala i-Bitcoin. Ngisho noma ubheka ibhizinisi lakho lonke ngamazwi e-Bitcoin, udinga ukubika inani ledola lokwenzeka ngakunye enteleleni yakho.
entries.targetTranslation: Amanye amabhizinisi akhetha ukugcina ingxenye ye-Bitcoin awayitholayo esikhundleni sokushintshelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma kunjalo, isinyathelo esikhulu sokwengeza ukulandelela isisekelo sakho sezindleko — inani ledola lenkokhelo nganye ye-Bitcoin ngosuku oyitholile.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Infleshini yenzeka lapho imali eningi iphrintwa noma yakhiwa emoyeni. Lokhu kwenza imali yakho ibe yize ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin inenani elimisiwe, okusho ukuthi akekho ongaphrinta i-Bitcoin eningi.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin inenani elimisiwe lezinhlamvu ezingu-21 million. Akekho uhulumeni, ibhange, noma inkampani engaphrinta okwengeziwe. Imali yakho elondolozwe nge-Bitcoin igcina inani layo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi esikhundleni sokuyilahla ngokuthula.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: Amabhange amaningi ase-US awe eminyakeni embalwa edlule ngenxa yokugijimela kwamabhange.
entries.targetTranslation: Amabhange amaningi ase-US awe eminyakeni embalwa edlule ngenxa yokugijimela kwamabhange. Lapho amakhasimende amaningi ezama ukukhipha imali ngesikhathi esisodwa, amabhange ayengenayo imali yokukhokhela wonke umuntu.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: Esikhundleni sokugcina nje imali yakho, amabhange atshala imali yakho futhi ayikhokhise. Uma lezo zitshalomali zingahambi kahle, awanawo amandla okukukhokha.
entries.targetTranslation: Esikhundleni sokugcina nje imali yakho, amabhange abolekisa futhi atshale eziningi zayo. Uma lezo zitshalomali zingahambi kahle — noma uma abafaki imali balahlekelwa ukwethemba — ibhange lingahluleka, futhi izimali zakho ezifakwe zingavalwa noma zilahleke.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: Futhi isikhwama somshwalense se-FDIC sinokwemali engu-$1 ngayo yonke engu-$100 esiyishwalensayo.
entries.targetTranslation: Nge-Bitcoin, ungabamba imali yakho ngqo esikhwameni sakho. Akukho bhange. Akekho umphakathi. Akukho ukugijimela kwebhange.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Ngokungafani nezinethiwekhi zezezimali zendabuko, i-Bitcoin ayidingi imvume ukusetshenziswa.
entries.targetTranslation: Ngokungafani namakhadi esikweletu, i-PayPal, noma ama-akhawunti ebhange wendabuko, i-Bitcoin ayidingi imvume yamuntu ukuze isetshenziswe.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: Lokho kusho ukuthi akekho ongakuvimba ukusebenzisa i-Bitcoin nganoma isiphi isizathu. Iyinethiwekhi yokuqala yezezimali ongayisebenzisa ngaphandle kokwesaba ukuvinjelwa noma ukuthathwa.
entries.targetTranslation: Akekho ongavala i-akhawunti yakho, avimbe inkokhelo, noma akugcine engadlulisi enethiwekhi. Yiyona sistimu yokuqala yezezimali emlandweni ongasebenzisa ngenkululeko, ngaphandle kokwesaba ukuvinjelwa noma ukubanjwa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin iyithekhinoloji engaqondwa kahle eyakha umhlaba ongcono.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ngokuvamile ayiqondwa kahle, kodwa yenza okuningi okuhle ngokuthula emhlabeni.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.
entries.englishValue: It has helped human rights activists fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions from landfills and oil fields, stabilized electric grids, and funded public goods like national parks.
entries.currentValue: I-Bitcoin ivumele abalweli bamalungelo abantu ukulwela inkululeko, yanciphisa ukukhishwa kwegesi emhlabeni, yasindisa iziqiwu zezwe, nokunye okuningi.
entries.targetTranslation: Iye yasiza abalweli bamalungelo abantu balwele inkululeko, yanciphisa ukukhishwa kwe-methane emhlabeni emagqumeni odoti namasimini ka-oyili, yazinzisa amagridi agesi, futhi yaxhasa izinto zomphakathi ezifana namaphaki ezwe.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Ukwamukela i-Bitcoin ebhizinisini lakho akudingi ukwenza ukubala amabhuku kube nzima. Nansi inguqulo emfushane — kanye namathuluzi nongoti abenza kungabi buhlungu.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Uma uvele wamukela imali noma ikhadi, ukufaka i-Bitcoin emabhukwini ebhizinisi lakho kulula kunalokho okubukekayo. Unezindlela ezimbili: ushintshele ngokuzenzakalelayo yonke inkokhelo ye-Bitcoin iye kumadola ngomzuzu efika ngawo (akudingi kubala amabhuku okusha), noma ugcine enye njenge-Bitcoin (zimbalwa izinombolo zokwengeza zokulandelela).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Lo mhlahlandlela ukuhambisa kuzo zombili — ukuze ukhethe okuhambelana nebhizinisi lakho futhi uqale ukwamukela i-Bitcoin ngokuzethemba.

entries.targetTranslation: Uthengisa kuwebhusayithi? Lezi zikhwama ziyaxhumana esitolo sakho se-online futhi zamukela i-Bitcoin kunoma yiliphi ikhasimende, kunoma kuphi emhlabeni — akukho kubuyiselwa, akudingeki i-akhawunti yomthengisi.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Izikhwama zamabhizinisi aphethwe ngabantu ngabodwana

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Uma uphethe isitolo, ikhefi, isitudiyo, noma insizakalo wedwa, noma yisiphi salezi zikhwama sizosebenza. Khetha kusekelwe ekutheni ufuna ukugcina izinkokhelo nge-Bitcoin noma ushintshele ngokuzenzakalelayo ingxenye yenkokhelo nganye eye kumali yakho yendawo.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Strike Business ikuvumela ukwamukela izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin ne-Lightning ngezimali ezingu-zero futhi nokuxazulula ngokushesha. Isekela izinkokhelo zomuntu obonayo, e-online, nezisekelwe ezi-invoyisi nge-conversion ezenzakalelayo eya kumali yakho yendawo.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Izimali eziphansi, kuningi okusele ebhizinisini

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin zeqa amabhange nezinkampani zamakhadi esikweletu ezithatha u-2–3% kuyo yonke inkokhelo. Ibhizinisi ligcina okwengeziwe kwalokho okukhokhayo — okuvame ukusho amanani angcono nesevisi engcono kuwe.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Ukuxazululwa ngokushesha, akukho kubuyiselwa

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Izinkokhelo ze-Bitcoin zixazululwa ngemizuzwana, ngqo zisuka esikhwameni sakho ziya ebhizinisini. Akukho ukulinda izinsuku ukuze ibhange likhulule izimali, futhi azikho izimpikiswano zokubuyiselwa ezibizayo — ngakho ibhizinisi lingaba esevisini yokukhonza amakhasimende esikhundleni sokulwa nokukhwabanisa.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Mahhala ukwamukela, kuvulekele wonke umuntu

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Azikho izinkontileka, izimali zenyanga, noma izindleko zokuhlela zebhizinisi ukuze lamukele i-Bitcoin. Futhi izigidi zabasebenzisi be-Bitcoin emhlabeni wonke bayasifuna abathengisi abamukela — bukugixe ibhizinisi mahhala kumakhasimende amasha.

entries.englishValue: Why Bitcoin is great for this business

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Ukwamukela i-Bitcoin kuvumela ibhizinisi ukugcina okwengeziwe kuyo yonke ukuthengiswa, ukukhokhwa ngokushesha ngaphandle kokubuyiselwa, nokufinyelela isizukulwane somhlaba sabasebenzisi be-Bitcoin — konke ngaphandle kwezinkontileka nezimali zenyanga.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin ayisebenzi kuphela emshini wokukhokha — iyimali engcono evikela imali yakho elondolozwe, ubumfihlo bakho, nenkululeko yakho yokuthengisa. Nansi inkomba esheshayo.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Usanda kusikena isitika esithi I-Bitcoin Yamukelwa Lapha. Nansi indaba enhle — kuleli bhizinisi nakuwe.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Ibhizinisi lapho ukhona lamukela i-Bitcoin — inethiwekhi yezinkokhelo yesimanje, evulekile, enoma ubani angayisebenzisa, kunoma kuphi emhlabeni, ngaphandle kwamabhange noma abaphakathi abathathayo.

entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Ama-Nostr client azinhlelo zokusebenza zamahhala ezikuvumela ukufunda nokuposa ku-Nostr network. Wonke ayasebenzelana — ungashintsha ama-client nganoma yisiphi isikhathi futhi ugcine abalandeli bakho nokuqukethwe.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Nostr iyiphrothokholi entsha eyahlukanisiwe yokuxhumana online — ayikho inkampani eyodwa eyilawulayo, ama-zaps e-Bitcoin akhelwe ngaphakathi, futhi ungashintsha phakathi kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa abalandeli bakho.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Yini i-Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Nostr ifana ne-imeyili: akekho onomthetho woMthethosivivinywayo, noma ubani angakha uhlelo lokusebenza kuwo, futhi ungakhetha noma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza oluthandayo. Ngokungafani ne-Twitter noma i-Facebook, ayikho inkampani esiyinhloko engakuvalela, ikususe enkundleni, noma ikunciphise.

entries.englishValue: Protocol, not platform
entries.targetTranslation: Iphrothokholi, hhayi inkundla

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Nostr iyiphrothokholi entsha ekuvumela ukuxhumana online ngaphandle kokwesaba ukuvinjelwa, ukukhishwa enkundleni, noma ukunciphisa.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Izinkundla ezifana ne-Twitter ne-Facebook zilawulwa inkampani eyodwa, kodwa akekho olawula iphrothokholi ye-Nostr.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Inkululeko yokuhamba

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: I-Nostr ifana ne-imeyili. Akekho olawula iphrothokholi ye-imeyili, futhi noma ubani angakha i-client (efana ne-Gmail, Hotmail, njll.) phezu kwayo.

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Akekho olawula iphrothokholi ye-Nostr nayo, futhi noma ubani angakha i-client (efana ne-Damus, Amethyst, njll.) phezu kwayo.

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Uma ungayithandi indlela esebenza ngayo i-client ethile, ungahambisa ngokugeleza i-akhawunti yakho ye-Nostr ku-client enye ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa abalandeli noma okuqukethwe.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin yakhelwe ngaphakathi

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: I-Bitcoin yakhelwe ngaphakathi ngokwemvelo kuphrothokholi ye-Nostr. Uma ubona okuqukethwe okuthandayo, ungatshi i-Bitcoin kalula kothile njengokubonga!

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Ezinkundleni ezigcizelelwe ngalinye njenge-Twitter ne-Facebook, inkampani egcizelelwe ithola imali kokuqukethwe kwakho. Kodwa kuziphrothokholi ezivulekile ezifana ne-Nostr, uthola imali kokuqukethwe kwakho.
